subject: Telemetry pilot wrap-up: outcomes + quick quote/call?
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@horizon.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry pilot wrap-up: outcomes + quick quote/call?

Hi Sofia (and Evan),

First — huge thanks for partnering on this telemetry POC. Team Horizon was excellent to work with and we got through the integration very quickly. Attaching the executive results PDF (summary + raw charts) for your records. TL;DR of the outcome we've been tracking: 

• Average inference latency on the critical pipeline reduced from 210ms -> 62ms (3.4x improvement)
• Cost per 1M tokens served dropped ~43% due to caching + batching improvements
• 99.4% request success rate during the two-week steady-state window
• Integration effort: 2 full engineer-days to get to production replica and 1 pilot-only engineer for monitoring

We have a short marketing ask: would Horizon be open to either a 1–2 sentence customer quote we can use in a one-page case highlight, or a quick 10-minute call where we capture a short soundbite? If it helps, I drafted two one-liners you could adapt: 

  • “Redwood cut our inference latency by over 3x and materially reduced token costs — a game changer for our real-time stack.”
  • “Integration was fast and low-friction; we started seeing production gains within 48 hours.”

If you prefer the call, our calendar is flexible next week — happy to coordinate. 

Attachments: telemetry_poc_results_20280314.pdf

Thanks again,
Irene
Irene Choi
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@horizon.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Chu <evan.chu@horizon.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry pilot wrap-up: outcomes + quick quote/call?

Hi Irene — appreciate the clear summary and the file. The results look great on our side too; the latency drop and cost reduction are exactly what we needed for the real-time feature rollout.

You have permission to use Horizon AI's name and logo for a short case highlight. We’re happy to provide a 1–2 sentence quote now — feel free to use this:

  “Working with Redwood Inference reduced our inference latency by more than threefold and significantly lowered our per-token costs, enabling a smoother launch of real-time features.”

If you want a quick call to capture a verbal soundbite, I can do 15 minutes on Monday 3/19 at 10:30am PT — Evan will join for any technical detail.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Data Platform | Horizon AI
sofia.ramos@horizon.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@horizon.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry pilot wrap-up: outcomes + quick quote/call?

Amazing — thanks Sofia, really appreciate the prompt permission and the quote. We’ll include that in a short one-page highlight. 

Irene / Neha: I attached a one-page case study outline (case_study_outline_20280315.docx) — it’s minimal: headline, challenge, approach, metrics, quote, and approved logo usage.

Sofia — I’ve provisionally added a 15-minute Google Meet on Mon 19 Mar 2028 10:30am PT (link below). If that works, no prep required; we’ll capture a 30–45 second on-camera quote and confirm logo/attribution language.

Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/rwi-hzqv-4zc

If legal needs to sign off on logo usage, point me at your internal contact and we’ll send a short permissions mail.

Thanks again — both for the pilot and for saying yes on the quote.
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@horizon.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry pilot wrap-up: outcomes + quick quote/call?

Perfect — all set on our end. I’ve uploaded the final metrics slide and product screenshots to the shared Drive folder (link included in metadata). We’ll use the quote you provided verbatim unless you tell us otherwise.

Next steps (internal): Marcus will finalize the one-pager for design; Neha to coordinate legal/brand for logo usage.

Sofia — see you on Monday at 10:30am PT. If anything changes, just reply to this thread.

Best,
Irene
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
